problems.problem: Target segment mismatch: the company is an IT managed service provider rather than a home-services trade contractor.
problems.label: inference
problems.basis: IT Secure LLC offers managed IT, cybersecurity, network administration, and cloud services to businesses, placing it outside ForgeX's target market of owner-led residential HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors.

problems.problem: Broken pricing page link on public website.
problems.label: inference
problems.basis: The link https://itsecure.tech/pricing/ included in the primary website navigation bar and footer returns a 404 not-found error.

existingSolutions.addresses: Broken pricing link by either unlinking the navigation item or redirecting it until content is live.
Lead booking and inbound web inquiries.

feasibility.explanation: No ForgeX solutions are applicable because IT Secure LLC operates in commercial IT services and cybersecurity rather than residential home services.

aiDelivery.explanation: Custom ForgeX AI agents are not recommended as the company is outside ForgeX's target market segment and already offers its own IT, cloud, and AI solutions.

humanReview: No ForgeX workflow implementations are planned or proposed.

risks.description: Engaging businesses outside the core home-service contractor segment wastes business development resources on companies that do not use field-service software or pay for residential job leads.

qualification.rationale: IT Secure LLC is a managed service provider (MSP) offering business IT infrastructure support, cybersecurity, cloud administration, and MDM solutions in Meridian, Idaho. It is not an owner-led home-service contractor in the HVAC, plumbing, or electrical trades. Because it falls outside ForgeX's target industry segment and provides its own technology and automation consulting services, it is qualified as 'not a fit'.
